CVE-2023-0179.description: Stack-based buffer overflow in nf_tables VLAN payload handling. An integer underflow when computing 'ethlen' (u8) lets an attacker-controlled memcpy write up to 255 bytes into a 4-byte stack buffer.

CVE-2024-53141.description: Missing range check in bitmap_ip_uadt: when IPSET_ATTR_IP_TO is absent but IPSET_ATTR_CIDR is present, ip/ip_to values are swapped and the range check for ip is skipped, allowing an out-of-bounds write.

CVE-2025-22064.description: nf_tables_updchain rolls back hook registration on error unconditionally, but the hook is never registered when the table is flagged dormant (inactive), so the rollback path unregisters a hook that was never registered.
